description: Imports an OpenAPI spec (JSON or YAML; path or URL such as http://localhost:3000/openapi.json), a cURL command, or a Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, Thunder Client, Hoppscotch or SignOff export into a new collection in the workspace, using the app's own import pipeline. Literal credentials become {{variables}} so nothing secret is written. Existing collections are never changed.

environments.description: Also create the source's environments (default true; secrets stay blank)

name.description: Name for the new collection (default: from the source)

path.description: File path (relative paths are inside the workspace)

text.description: Inline content, e.g. a cURL command

url.description: URL to download, e.g. a running service's /openapi.json

name: import_requests

variablesForSecrets.description: Variables that replaced literal credentials; their values belong in .env

title: Import requests into the workspace
